Crowd evacuating a room through a three-cell doorway

A crowd emptying a room through a doorway three cells wide.

What to watch for

The green-to-red wash is the flow field — the model's own gradient towards the exit, with green near it. The crowding at the door is not scripted; it is what happens when everyone follows that gradient at once.

Underneath

This is a real run of a real model, not a recording. The page fetched the trace (352 KB gzipped) and drew it through the same renderer the desktop animation application uses. Download it and open it there to lay it out yourself.

Read the model's source — the simulation is not modified to be animated; capture is a flag on a run.
